description: This file implements a shell script for configuring and managing an IPv6-in-IPv4 tunnel using 6rd in an OpenWrt environment. It contains functions for setting up and tearing down the tunnel, initializing configuration, and managing routing and address assignment.

methods.name: proto_6rd_setup
methods.description: Configures the IPv6-in-IPv4 6rd tunnel with parameters supplied via arguments and JSON configuration, including address assignment, route setup, and tunnel parameters.

methods.name: proto_6rd_teardown
methods.description: Placeholder for tearing down the 6rd tunnel, currently empty.

methods.name: proto_6rd_init_config
methods.description: Initializes the configuration options for the 6rd protocol, defining which parameters can be set by the user.
